summary.text: Abbie Groff-Blaszak is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4 Democratic primary.
An educator, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her campaign centers on a worker-centered economy and affordable housing.

paragraphs.text: Groff-Blaszak graduated from East Kentwood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University Bloomington in 2000, and a graduate degree from the Harvard Graduate School of Education in 2004.
Ballotpedia also lists coursework at Grand Rapids Community College in 2022.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in Michigan's Upper Peninsula and considers West Michigan home.
Her survey described a worker-centered economy that would raise the minimum wage, establish a paid family leave program, work toward universal childcare, and end non-compete clauses.
She also listed adequate, affordable and accessible housing among her key messages.
